lights.action: Immediately stop the vehicle in a safe place and contact your Lexus dealer.

lights.name: Low engine oil pressure warning light
lights.meaning: Indicates that the engine oil pressure is too low.
lights.action: Immediately stop the vehicle in a safe place and contact your Lexus dealer.

lights.name: Malfunction indicator lamp
lights.meaning: Indicates a malfunction in: The electronic engine control system; The hybrid system (LC500h); The electronic throttle control system; The electronic automatic transmission control system (LC500); or The electronic hybrid transmission control system (LC500h).
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: SRS warning light
lights.meaning: Indicates a malfunction in: The SRS airbag system; The front passenger occupant classification system; or The seat belt pretensioner system.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: ABS warning light
lights.meaning: Indicates a malfunction in: The ABS; or The brake assist system.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: Electric power steering system warning light
lights.meaning: Or (yellow) Indicates a malfunction in the EPS (Electric Power Steering) system.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: PCS warning light
lights.meaning: (Flashes or illuminates) When a buzzer sounds simultaneously: Indicates a malfunction has occurred in the PCS (Pre-Collision System); When a buzzer does not sound: The PCS (Pre-Collision System) has become temporarily unavailable, corrective action may be necessary.;, 393) If the PCS (Pre-Collision System) or VSC (Vehicle Stability Control) system is disabled, the PCS warning light will illuminate.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately. Follow the instructions displayed on the multi-information display.

lights.name: LTA indicator
lights.meaning: (orange) Indicates a malfunction in the LTA (Lane Tracing Assist).
lights.action: Follow the instructions displayed on the multi-information display.

lights.name: Slip indicator
lights.meaning: Indicates a malfunction in: The VSC (Vehicle Stability Control) system; The TRAC (Traction Control) system; or The hill-start assist control system; The light will flash when the VSC, TRAC, ABS, VGRS* or DRS* system is operating.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: Brake Override System warning light/Drive-Start Control warning light
lights.meaning: When a buzzer sounds: Indicates a malfunction in the Brake Override System or Drive-Start Control; Indicates that the shift position was changed while depressing the accelerator pedal and Drive-Start Control was operated; Momentarily release the accelerator pedal. When a buzzer does not sound: Indicates that the accelerator and brake pedals are being depressed simultaneously.
lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately. Release the accelerator pedal and depress the brake pedal.

lights.name: Brake hold operated indicator

lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer.

lights.name: Parking brake indicator

lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: Brake system warning light

lights.action: Have the vehicle inspected by your Lexus dealer immediately.

lights.name: Low fuel level warning light

lights.action: Refuel the vehicle.

lights.name: High coolant temperature warning light
lights.meaning: Indicates that the engine coolant temperature is too high.
lights.action: Immediately stop the vehicle in a safe place.

lights.name: Hybrid system overheat warning light

lights.name: Charging system warning light

lights.name: Low engine oil pressure warning light

lights.name: Malfunction indicator lamp

lights.name: SRS warning light
lights.meaning: Indicates a malfunction in: The SRS airbag system; or The seat belt pretensioner system.

lights.name: ABS warning light
lights.meaning: Or Indicates a malfunction in: The ABS; or The brake assist system.

lights.name: Inappropriate pedal operation warning light
lights.meaning: When a buzzer sounds: Brake Override System is malfunctioning; When a buzzer does not sound: Brake Override System is operating.

lights.name: Electric power steering system warning light

lights.name: Rear passengers’ seat belt reminder light

When the power limitation indicator light is illuminated with the power switch in the READY to drive position, the power provided to the traction motor is reduced. Therefore the vehicle is not as responsive when the accelerator is depressed while the power limitation indicator light is illuminated.
lights.action: It is recommended that you contact a NISSAN certified LEAF dealer.

If the light flickers or illuminates during normal driving, pull off the road in a safe area, stop the engine immediately and call a NISSAN dealer or other authorized repair shop. The engine oil pressure warning light is not designed to indicate a low oil level. Use the dipstick to check the oil level.

After starting the engine, the engine oil pressure warning light turns off. This indicates that the oil pressure sensors in the engine are operational.
lights.action: Stop the vehicle safely as soon as possible. Stop the engine immediately and call a NISSAN dealer.

lights.name: Hands OFF warning light

lights.name: Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) warning light
lights.meaning: When the ignition switch is in the ON position, the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) warning light illuminates and then turns off. This indicates the ABS is operational. If the ABS warning light illuminates while the engine is running, or while driving, it may indicate the ABS is not functioning properly. If an ABS malfunction occurs, the antilock function is turned off.
lights.action: Have the system checked. It is recommended you visit a NISSAN dealer for this service.

lights.meaning: This indicator will blink when the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC) system is operating, thus alerting that the vehicle is nearing its traction limits. The road surface may be slippery. You may feel or hear the system working; this is normal. The light will blink for a few seconds after the VDC system stops limiting wheel spin. The indicator light also comes on when you place the ignition switch in the ON position.

lights.name: Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC) OFF indicator light

lights.name: Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) warning light
lights.meaning: When the ignition switch is in the ON position, the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) warning light illuminates and then turns off. This indicates the ABS is operational. If the ABS warning light illuminates while the engine is running, or while driving, it may indicate the ABS is not functioning properly. If an ABS malfunction occurs, the antilock function is turned off.
lights.action: Have the system checked. It is recommended you visit a NISSAN dealer for this service.

lights.name: Automatic transmission check warning light
lights.meaning: When the ignition switch is pushed to the ON position, the light comes on for 2 seconds. If the light comes on at any other time, it may indicate the transmission is not functioning properly.
lights.action: It is recommended you visit a NISSAN dealer to check and repair the transmission.

lights.name: Brake warning light
lights.meaning: This light functions for both the parking brake and the foot brake systems. Parking brake indicator: When the ignition switch is in the ON position, the light comes on when the parking brake is applied. Low brake fluid warning light: When the ignition switch is in the ON position, the light warns of a low brake fluid level.
lights.action: Check the brake fluid level. Add brake fluid as necessary. It is recommended you have this service performed by a NISSAN dealer.

lights.name: Charge warning light
lights.meaning: If the light comes on while the engine is running, it may indicate the charging system is not functioning properly. If the belt is loose, broken, missing or if the light remains on, have your vehicle serviced immediately. CAUTION Do not continue driving if the alternator belt is loose, broken or miss.
lights.action: Turn the engine off and check the alternator belt. It is recommended you visit a NISSAN dealer for this service.

lights.name: Engine oil pressure warning light
lights.meaning: This light warns of low engine oil pressure. If the light flickers or comes on during normal driving, pull off the road in a safe area, stop the engine immediately and call a NISSAN dealer or other authorized repair shop. The engine oil pressure warning light is not designed to indicate a low oil level. Use the dipstick to check the oil level.
lights.action: Turn off the engine as soon as it is safe to do so.

lights.name: Master warning light
